title: Master Data (Move-Out)
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:39 AM
In Customizing under |)!Vove-In/Out » Move-Out Define Move-Out Control Parameters at Contract Level 3, you can specify that
an immediate bill is created automatically when the move-out id saved.

Master Data (Move-Out)

Use

If the move-out date is in a period for which one of the installations was already billed, the system does not permit you to create

the move-out. You must reverse the billing before you can process the move-out.
You can find additional information in the section on the Master data component.

You can save changes to business partner and contract account data as scheduled changes. This means that the changes are not
activated until a future date. This date is determined by subtracting the interval period defined in Customizing from the move-out
date. For more information on how to define the interval period, see Customizing under |SAP Utilities Customer Service

Process Execution » Move-In/Move-Out » Define System Parameters for Move-in and Move-Out j. Scheduled changes are
activated by report BUSPCDACT (activation of scheduled change documents for an application object).

Move-out Confirmation Letter

Use

When you create or change a move-out, you can print a move-out confirmation letter. To do this, use the application form of the

form class IS_U_CS_-MOVE_OUT_NOTIFICATION. You must define this application form in Customizing under |)sMove-In/Out
Move-Out ‘+ Define Move-Out Confirmation Letter "J ). Under |jsMove-Out Define Move-Out Control Parameters at Document

Level 3, you can configure the system to automatically use u user-defined an application form each time you attempt to print a
move-out confirmation letter.

You can find additional information on creating an application form in the section on the Print workbench component.

Meter Reading Data (Move-Out)

Use

When you create a move-out, the system automatically creates a meter reading order for all the meter reading-relevant registers
that belong to the devices allocated to the installation for billing purposes. A prerequisite is that you have not entered a meter
reading.

In Customizing under {Utilities Industry } Customer Service » Process Execution » Move-In/Out + Move-Out » Define Move-
Out Control Parameters at Contract Level “J, you can determine how these meter reading orders are processed.

e Allregisters to be read by the customer (according to the planned meter reading type) can be printed on a card for meter
reading by customer.

e All registers to be read by the utility company (according to the planned meter reading type) flow into a PM-SMA service
order, or be printed on an IS-U form for meter reading by the meter reader.
